knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
Load in the data
```{r}
Elev <- read_csv("../input/Pop_elev_data.csv")
CP2_Y1 <- read_csv("../input/CP2_Y1_viability_data.csv")
Control_Y1 <- read_csv("../input/Y1_Control_lab_stored_seed_viability_data.csv")
```
Add in the elevation data
```{r}
Elev <- Elev %>%
  select(c("Pop", "Elev_m", "Elev_class")) #Selecting relevant columns to join with other data sets

Control_Y1 <- Control_Y1 %>%
  left_join(Elev, by="Pop") #join in elevation and elevation class using the pop codes
#write_csv(Control_Y1, "../output/Control_Y1_w_elev.csv")

CP2_Y1 <- CP2_Y1 %>%
  left_join(Elev, by="Pop") #join in elevation and elevation class using the pop codes
#write_csv(CP2_Y1, "../output/CP2_Y1_w_elev.csv")

```
